description: Chart 01 — Compact statewide venue density check. A binned 2-D histogram of Victoria's ~23,658 licensed-venue coordinates: longitude and latitude are each binned, and colour counts the venues falling in each cell (square-root scale so regional centres stay visible against the Melbourne core). It is deliberately demoted after the Melbourne overlay: the statewide grid mainly proves why the close-up is necessary, because the strongest signal is the Melbourne concentration. Latitude increases upward and longitude rightward, so the grid still reads as a map of the state; the projected maps carry the coastline. Data: venues_web.csv.
